evals.prompt: You are the delegated BHE environment operator. Load both official sample datasets into the task-owned isolated stack and report when analysis completes.
evals.expected_output: The same exclusive environment operator performs ingest, verifies completion, and reports the resulting environments without creating a second ingest agent.
expectations: Keeps ingest inside the existing environment-operator lane
Does not delegate shared-state mutation to a concurrent agent
Verifies the exact task-owned target before authenticating or uploading
Reports job completion, failures, and available AD and Entra environments

evals.prompt: Load the AD sample dataset into my already-running standalone BHE development stack. No change-delivery orchestrator is involved.
evals.expected_output: The agent establishes sole mutation ownership of the named stack and performs the focused AD ingest directly.
expectations: Checks that no other agent is operating or ingesting into the target stack
Does not spawn a sub-agent when no useful parallel lane exists
Uses the requested AD-only dataset and verifies completion

evals.prompt: Speed this up by having one agent ingest AD and another ingest Entra into the same local BHE stack at the same time.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses concurrent mutation of the same stack and keeps both datasets under one environment operator and ingest lifecycle.
expectations: Does not create concurrent ingest agents for one stack
Explains the shared job and stack-state ownership conflict
Runs the requested datasets sequentially within one operator lane
